Class Bot

java.lang.Object
splendor.entity.player.Player
splendor.entity.bot.Bot
Direct Known Subclasses:
EasyBot, HardBot
public abstract class Bot extends Player
Abstract base class for all bot players. Provides shared helper methods for gem evaluation, card scoring, noble tracking, and move execution.
